findings.summary: test_evaluation_task_promotes_when_threshold_zero fails deterministically on any dev machine where ./checkpoints/best_v*.pt exists; EvaluationConfig::default() sets checkpoints_dir='checkpoints', and the pool-is-nonempty-but-no-opponent arm skips the promotion gate (continue at line 530). Expected version=5, actual version=0.

Bootstrap-fallback WARN condition `if champion_version > 0` fires a false alarm when the only archive on disk is best_v{champion_version}.pt itself (pool.rs excludes current champion from the returned list).
